q: How do I calculate an amusement park's carbon footprint per visitor?
title: Amusement park CO2 per visitor
short: Rides, lighting and food courts run on electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, with diesel generators for backup. Divide by visitors for a per visitor figure. Ride motors draw heavily at start up, so off peak days with few riders raise the per visitor number.

ul: Electricity by ride zone where metered.

p: LPG for kitchens is Scope 1; food bought in is Scope 3. Leased outlets on their own meters report their own power.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
